node.label: Short-segment aganglionic megacolon
node.definition: A type of aganglionic megacolon in which the aganglionic segment does not extend beyond the upper sigmoid.

evidence.snippet: Peripheral demyelinating neuropathy, central dysmyelination, Waardenburg syndrome, and Hirschsprung disease: Short-segment aganglionic megacolon (frequency 1/3) [PCS]
